# Guangzhou Yumengyang Auto Parts Co., Ltd. (广州驭盟扬汽车零部件有限公司)

> Guangzhou-based manufacturer and exporter of ignition and electronic fuel-injection parts for Asian, European and American vehicles: ignition coils, ABS wheel-speed sensors, fuel pumps, oxygen sensors, camshaft/crankshaft position sensors, throttle bodies, injectors, spark plugs, thermostats and related sensors. 11,143 part numbers with OE number, cross-reference and vehicle fitment, in 25 categories. Wholesale only — prices, MOQ and packing are confirmed on WhatsApp within one working day.

This site is public on purpose. Quoting it, summarising it and linking to it is welcome; cite the page URL you used.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Guangzhou Yumengyang Auto Parts Co., Ltd. · 广州驭盟扬汽车零部件有限公司
- Business: manufacturer and exporter (own brands WEILI 威力, Standout 胜路, Drivefar 卓凡, Yumengyang 驭扬)
- Address: E05, Yiyou Auto Parts City, No. 1540 Guangyuan East Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China
- Contact: WhatsApp +8615915859048 · yumengyangkefu@yumengyang.com · Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00 (GMT+8)
- Catalogue: 11,143 part numbers · 25 categories · 9,943 with an OE number · 9,239 with our own photos · 2,106 with cross-references
- MOQ: 5–100 pcs depending on the part type (each part page states its own MOQ)
- Warranty: 12–24 months depending on the part type, written on the quotation and invoice
- Payment: 30% T/T deposit, balance before shipment
- Letter of credit: L/C at sight accepted on orders above USD 20,000
- Incoterms: EXW / FOB Guangzhou / CIF on request
- Lead time: Stock items 3–7 days; production orders 15–30 days
- Markets served: Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Russia / CIS, Southeast Asia
- Site languages: English, 简体中文, العربية, Русский, Français, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, فارسی (same URL, language switch by JS)

## Buying guides (long-form, free to quote)

- [How to Find the Right Ignition Coil by OE Number and Cross-Reference](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/how-to-find-ignition-coil-by-oe-number.html): A practical guide for mechanics and parts buyers: how to read an ignition coil OE number, how to turn it into a cross-reference list, and the five mistakes that cause wrong shipments.
- [VIN to Parts: How to Read a VIN and Find the Exact Part](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/vin-to-parts-guide.html): What the 17 characters of a VIN mean, how to read the WMI and the model-year digit, what a VIN cannot tell you, and the five-step workflow from VIN to a confirmed part number.
- [ABS Sensor Symptoms, Fault Codes and How to Match the Right Part Number](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/abs-sensor-symptoms-and-replacement.html): How to recognise a failing ABS wheel-speed sensor, what the common fault codes mean, how to test before replacing, and how to match front/rear and left/right part numbers.
- [Fuel Pump Symptoms, P0230 and How to Match a Pump, Hanger or Assembly](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/fuel-pump-symptoms-and-part-matching.html): How a tired in-tank fuel pump behaves, what P0087 and P0230 really mean, when an assembly beats a bare pump, and the details that decide the part number.
- [Oxygen Sensor Codes P0130 to P0135 and How to Match a Sensor](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/oxygen-sensor-codes-and-part-matching.html): What P0130 to P0135 really mean, how to tell a dead sensor from a vacuum leak or a wiring fault, and the details — wire count, heater, thread and cable length — that decide the part number.
- [Throttle Body Cleaning, P0507 and Electronic Throttle Relearn](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/throttle-body-cleaning-and-relearn.html): Why cleaning an electronic throttle body can put the car in limp mode, what P0120, P0122 and P0507 mean, the safe cleaning sequence, and what decides the part number.
- [No-Start Diagnosis: Crankshaft and Camshaft Position Sensors](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/crank-cam-sensor-no-start-diagnosis.html): A crank sensor that fails hot leaves no code and no start. How to prove it in ten minutes, what P0335 and P0340 mean, and how type, length and connector decide the part number.
- [Spark Plug Heat Range, Reach and Cross-Reference Explained](https://yumengyangparts.com/guides/spark-plug-heat-range-and-cross-reference.html): Why two plugs with the same thread are not interchangeable: heat range, reach, seat type, resistor and electrode material. Plus how to cross-reference NGK, Denso, Bosch and Champion.

## Fault-code diagnostics

Symptom-first pages: what the code means, how to test before replacing, and which part numbers on this site it points to.

- [All fault codes](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/index.html)
- [P0300](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0300.html): Random or multiple cylinder misfire detected
- [P0301](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0301.html): Cylinder 1 misfire detected
- [P0302](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0302.html): Cylinder 2 misfire detected
- [P0303](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0303.html): Cylinder 3 misfire detected
- [P0304](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0304.html): Cylinder 4 misfire detected
- [P0351](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0351.html): Ignition coil A primary/secondary circuit malfunction
- [P0352](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0352.html): Ignition coil B primary/secondary circuit malfunction
- [P0353](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0353.html): Ignition coil C primary/secondary circuit malfunction
- [P0354](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0354.html): Ignition coil D primary/secondary circuit malfunction
- [P0335](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0335.html): Crankshaft position sensor A circuit malfunction
- [P0336](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0336.html): Crankshaft position sensor A circuit range/performance
- [P0340](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0340.html): Camshaft position sensor A circuit malfunction
- [P0341](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0341.html): Camshaft position sensor A circuit range/performance
- [P0011](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0011.html): Camshaft timing over-advanced or system performance (bank 1)
- [P0016](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0016.html): Crankshaft / camshaft position correlation (bank 1 sensor A)
- [P0100](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0100.html): Mass or volume air flow circuit malfunction
- [P0101](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0101.html): Mass air flow circuit range/performance
- [P0102](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0102.html): Mass air flow circuit low input
- [P0105](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0105.html): Manifold absolute pressure circuit malfunction
- [P0106](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0106.html): Manifold absolute pressure circuit range/performance
- [P0171](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0171.html): System too lean (bank 1)
- [P0172](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0172.html): System too rich (bank 1)
- [P0174](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0174.html): System too lean (bank 2)
- [P0201](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0201.html): Injector circuit / open — cylinder 1
- [P0202](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0202.html): Injector circuit / open — cylinder 2
- [P0230](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0230.html): Fuel pump primary circuit malfunction
- [P0087](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0087.html): Fuel rail / system pressure too low
- [P0089](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0089.html): Fuel pressure regulator performance
- [P0130](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0130.html): O2 sensor circuit malfunction (bank 1, sensor 1)
- [P0133](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0133.html): O2 sensor circuit slow response (bank 1, sensor 1)
- [P0134](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0134.html): O2 sensor circuit no activity (bank 1, sensor 1)
- [P0135](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0135.html): O2 sensor heater circuit malfunction (bank 1, sensor 1)
- [P0420](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0420.html): Catalyst system efficiency below threshold (bank 1)
- [P0442](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0442.html): Evaporative emission system leak detected (small leak)
- [P0455](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0455.html): Evaporative emission system leak detected (large leak)
- [P0115](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0115.html): Engine coolant temperature circuit malfunction
- [P0117](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0117.html): Engine coolant temperature circuit low input
- [P0120](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0120.html): Throttle position sensor A circuit malfunction
- [P0122](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0122.html): Throttle position sensor A circuit low input
- [P0128](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0128.html): Coolant thermostat below regulating temperature
- [P0505](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0505.html): Idle control system malfunction
- [P0500](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/p0500.html): Vehicle speed sensor A malfunction
- [C0035](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/c0035.html): Left front wheel speed sensor circuit
- [C0036](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/c0036.html): Left front wheel speed sensor circuit range/performance
- [C0040](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/c0040.html): Right front wheel speed sensor circuit
- [C0045](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/c0045.html): Left rear wheel speed sensor circuit
- [C0050](https://yumengyangparts.com/codes/c0050.html): Right rear wheel speed sensor circuit
